name: Hitsville EQ
notes: Probed 2026-11-23. A graphic EQ: seven fixed bands (50 Hz to 12.5 kHz), +/-8 dB in 1 dB steps.

Another strip's four bands each go onto the nearest graphic band (gains add if two land on one); bands nobody uses go to 0 dB. Read back, the biggest boosts and cuts (up to four) become the shared bands. Q and band types don't carry: they stay remembered.
